scope: Joint-only preparation and swing experiments. Opening A is independently placed; no completed loop flip, Cup, boat or Star is certified.

loop_release_audit.json.scope: Necessary release diagnostics only; not a threading or figure certificate. Excludes swept collisions, full robot self-collision checks, rope-radius clearance at robot-body meshes and material identity. Central-body boxes and complete-edge arm/body hull checks are conservative: overlap does not by itself prove penetration of the original mesh.

interval_little_own_palm.scope: PIP/DIP capsules against their own convex palm; adjoining MCP excluded. Sampled poses, not full robot self-collision certification.

loop_release_audit.json.initialization: Independent placement, not replay of Position 1 or source dynamics

near_pinch_edge_audit.json.scope:
Check persistent same-material thumb/index contact during a stationary hold.

This is a sampled capsule-contact diagnostic, not a force-closure or figure
certificate. Run the physical release audit and original-support tracker too.
Edge mode permits the contacted fraction to move within one persistent material
edge; it does not establish persistence of a particular point on that edge.

near_pinch_strict_edge_audit.json.scope:
Check persistent same-material thumb/index contact during a stationary hold.

This is a sampled capsule-contact diagnostic, not a force-closure or figure
certificate. Run the physical release audit and original-support tracker too.
Edge mode permits the contacted fraction to move within one persistent material
edge; it does not establish persistence of a particular point on that edge.

dynamic_near_grip_audit.json.scope:
Check near-strand proximity and accidental old-loop pairing during motion.

This checks each recorded frame, without requiring a stationary hold. Contact
fractions and edges may change. It is not a force, topology, collision or
original-support certificate; run those separate diagnostics as well.

material_support_tracking.json.scope:
Follow original material supports through clamping and little-loop release.

This is a material-continuity diagnostic, not a threading certificate. Extra
contact patches remain in the report. Particle samples and enabled knuckle
meshes are checked; rope-edge contact alone cannot establish a material track.
The optional six-support audit also follows the original little loops before
their intended release and writes a separate report.

loop_throw_motion.json.scope:
Plot fixed free-loop material relative to the original thumb bridge.

The X/Z projection is a motion diagnostic, not a crossing or topology test.
Use it together with contact tracking, physical audits and the rendered motion.

control.scope:
Time common-wrist reversals from measured free-loop turning points or crossings.

This experimental controller reuses continue_cup's exact-state continuation and
collision guards. It observes privileged simulated rope state and commands only
robot joints. An elevated free band is a timing candidate, not a successful Cup.
Optional near-strand checks stop integration at the first rejected output
frame; they are not substep contact feedback.
control.phase_observation: Approach tracked during strokes; cues accepted after motion
control.timing_velocity: Three-frame finite difference of fixed-material relative positions
